body_markdown:
*Recognized in the Financial Technology (FinTech) & Commerce category*


November 24, 2026 (Plano, Texas) – Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that its[Digital Sales & Service Platform](https://www.alkami.com/) has been named the Gold Winner in the Digital Banking, Neobanking & WealthTech category of the[Merit Awards’ 2026 Technology Awards](https://www.merit-awards.com/winners-technology-2026) , within the broader Financial Technology (FinTech) & Commerce category. The Merit Awards’ Technology Awards recognize technology companies and solutions that deliver measurable impact. Alkami’s recognition reflects its Platform’s ability to bring continuity to the account holder experience, from account opening through ongoing digital service.


Alkami’s Digital Sales & Service Platform connects[MANTL Onboarding & Account Opening](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/) ,[Alkami Digital Banking](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) , and[Alkami Data & Marketing](https://www.alkami.com/data-marketing-solutions/) . By bringing these capabilities together in one unified Platform, Alkami helps financial institutions onboard, engage, and grow account holder relationships while creating a more connected experience across the account holder journey.


> “Alkami is honored that our Digital Sales & Service Platform has earned Gold, reflecting our commitment to our customers to deliver a continuous account holder journey from the moment an account is opened through every interaction that follows,” said Alex Shootman, chief executive officer of Alkami. “By bringing onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing together in a unified Platform, we help financial institutions compete with the megabanks all while growing their account holder relationships.”


The recognition follows additional honors Alkami received from Merit Awards earlier this year through its[2026 Marketing & Communications Awards](https://www.merit-awards.com/winners-marketing-communications-2026) , where the company was recognized in Content Marketing, Marketing Research, and Reputation & Thought Leadership Management.


For a full list of the 2026 winners of Merit Awards’ Technology Awards, visit[here](https://www.merit-awards.com/winners-technology-2026) .


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/anticipatory-banking/) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room/) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.
